title: Southampton boss Eckert revels in 'one of the best games the Championship could produce'
subtitle: FotMob
paragraphs: NewsAboutSouthampton boss Eckert revels in 'one of the best games the Championship could produce'ShareThe rivalry between Southampton and Middlesbrough was in full effect on Friday, with the Saints winning a tense Championship battle.Tonda Eckert described his Southampton side's victory over Middlesbrough as "one of the best games the Championship could produce".

The Saints won 2-0 at St. Mary's Stadium after second-half goals from Ryan Manning and Finn Azaz, with the latter running the full length of the pitch to celebrate in front of the away end against his former side.

Much of the build-up to the match was focused on the 'Spygate' scandal from the end of last season, but Southampton managed to put that to one side on Friday to move within four points of Championship leaders Boro.
Boro had their chances, accumulating 1.4 expected goals (xG) from 19 shots to Southampton's 1.12 from 12 attempts, but Kim Hellberg's side went scoreless again on the road.
They have failed to score in three consecutive Championship away games for the first time since January 2015, having 49 shots without success.
The Saints, meanwhile, extended their unbeaten run at home to 19 games in the league (W15 D4), and Eckert was delighted with the result.
"I think [that was] one of the best games the Championship could produce," Eckert told Sky Sports.
"There were moments that could go in both directions and I think over 90 minutes we deserved to win.
"This game brings emotions and you need to use them to your advantage.
"We've had a couple of games now that we went up and didn't play how we need to so I think that's a step forward.
"I am grateful to our club, to the supporters. The club had every right to make a different decision [after Spygate].
"The reality is we started on minus four and we are still playing catch up."
